review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Extent proven by section 20 row tiling: six bytes, one block, load-then-ret.

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: One block, zero edges on both sides; correct shape for a two-instruction getter.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: No argument and no stack access; one absolute read.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Single data address (dword at 0x00A70C7C); retail holds 0 in that word.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Emitted candidate matches the retail shape: mov 0x...,%eax ; ret.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail leaves the loaded value in EAX and callers may consume it, so the candidate returns it.

limitations: Static only; no runtime observation and the native sits behind the 0x00402930 boundary.
Retail symbol unknown; the name is an address-suffixed placeholder.
The meaning of the data word is unestablished and no writer of it has been identified among the transcribed natives.
